title: Skip invalid readings and stop when tank is full
goal: uses for…of, continue and break to manage the loop process.
summary: reads the volume of each package in sequence. Negative numbers in the array indicate invalid entries. The scanning of this box will end when the next package cannot be loaded.
tasks: complete fillCrate(volumes, limit). Negative numbers are skipped and other values ​​are accumulated sequentially.
The next item will stop immediately when the total exceeds the limit and return to the current total. Exactly equal to the capacity allowed to be loaded.

example.note: continue skips the current item, break exits the entire loop. The two deal with different situations in this question.

hint: Skip the invalid items first, and then compare total + volume and limit.
